about: The one list of KF2-VR player settings, shared by the launcher and its tests; the headset menus (VRSessionUI) use the same categories, labels and preset rules. Keys and stores are the saved names and never change; labels may. depth: everyday = a category's main page, customize = under that page's Customize row, setup = the launcher's Setup page. owner: the preset whose label a hand edit turns to CUSTOM, or player. applies: live (also in the headset), next_launch, launch_only.

first_time_setup.label: First-time setup
first_time_setup.help: A few choices to start with; you can change any of them later in Settings. ★ marks our recommendation.

PreferredWeaponHand.0: Left-handed: your watch is on your right wrist and you move with the right stick.
PreferredWeaponHand.1: Right-handed: your watch is on your left wrist and you move with the left stick.

bSeatedPlay.True: Raises your view so you can play sitting down.

LocomotionMode.1: Aim with the stick and let go to jump there.

bSnapTurn.True: Turn in quick 30° steps (change the angle in {menu}).

bDamagePopups.False: No numbers when you hit Zeds.
bDamagePopups.True: Shows the damage you deal over Zeds' heads.

reload_mode.label: Reload mode
reload_mode.help: How you reload and cycle guns.

options.label: Button
options.help: Press a button to reload; guns rack and cycle themselves, as in the normal game.
options.short: press a button, guns cycle themselves

options.label: Manual
options.help: Swap mags and rack slides, bolts and pumps by hand. An empty trigger pull starts the reload and a new mag pushes out the old one.
options.short: mags and racking by hand, with help

options.label: Realistic
options.help: Everything by hand, with no help: eject the old mag yourself, rack slides, bolts and pumps, and you can rack a loaded gun.

ammo_rules.label: Ammo rules
ammo_rules.requires_reason: show with Manual or Realistic reloads
ammo_rules.help: How rounds are counted when you reload by hand.

options.label: Standard
options.help: Rounds are counted as in the normal game.
options.short: counted as in the normal game

options.label: Realistic
options.help: A reload keeps the round in the chamber, and a dropped mag's rounds are lost unless you pick it up.
options.short: chambered rounds and dropped mags count

grip_mode.label: Grip mode
grip_mode.help: How grip holds guns in each hand.

options.label: Mixed
options.help: One press holds a gun in your gun hand; your other hand holds only while you squeeze.

options.label: Hold
options.help: Both hands hold only while you squeeze grip.

options.label: Toggle
options.help: Both hands: press grip to hold, press again to let go.
options.short: press once to hold, again to let go

locomotion.label: Locomotion
locomotion.help: Smooth or Teleport movement, with Snap or Smooth turning.

hud_preset.label: HUD preset
hud_preset.help: What the watch and gun show you.

options.label: Standard
options.help: Watch and the ammo counter on the gun.

graphics_preset.label: Graphics preset
graphics_preset.help: Overall detail and lighting. Render scale, DLSS, Bloom and Gore & bodies are separate settings.

options.label: Quality
options.help: The most detail and lighting; needs a fast graphics card.

options.label: Balanced
options.help: Less detail and lighting, for a steadier frame rate.

options.label: Performance
options.help: The least detail, for the highest frame rate.

settings.label: Manual reloading
settings.help: Reload and cycle guns by hand. Off: X / A reloads.

settings.label: Rack a loaded gun
settings.help: Working the action on a loaded gun throws out the chambered round, which is lost.

settings.label: Auto-eject on empty trigger
settings.help: Pulling the trigger on an empty gun ejects the mag, as X / A does, instead of clicking.
settings.requires_reason: Only with Manual or Realistic reloads

settings.label: Auto-eject on new mag
settings.help: Taking a mag from your pouch drops the one in the gun, so you don't eject it first.
settings.requires_reason: Only with Manual or Realistic reloads

settings.label: Button ejects a full mag
settings.help: X / A drops the mag even when it's full; a part-used mag always drops.
settings.requires_reason: Only with Manual or Realistic reloads

settings.label: Sprint while reloading
settings.help: Keep running while you reload by hand instead of pausing your sprint.
settings.requires_reason: Only with Manual or Realistic reloads

settings.label: Perk reload assist
settings.help: Perks that reload faster also guide mags into the gun.
settings.requires_reason: Only with Manual or Realistic reloads

settings.label: Keep chambered round
settings.help: A reload before the gun is empty keeps the round in the chamber.
settings.requires_reason: Only with Manual or Realistic reloads

settings.label: Dropped mags lose their rounds
aliases: Lose Rounds in a Dropped Mag
settings.help: Rounds left in a mag you drop, or live rounds you eject from a cylinder, are lost.
settings.requires_reason: Only with Manual or Realistic reloads

settings.label: Recover dropped mags
aliases: Pick It Up to Get Them Back
settings.help: Pick a dropped mag back up to get its rounds back.
settings.requires_reason: Only with lost rounds in dropped mags

settings.label: Main grip
settings.help: Toggle: a grabbed gun stays in your hand until you drop it. Hold: keep squeezing.

settings.label: Support grip
settings.help: Hold: squeeze to keep your other hand on pumps and grips. Toggle: press once on, once off.

settings.label: Support-hand carry
settings.help: Let go with your gun hand and your other hand keeps holding a two-handed gun by its foregrip. It can't fire until your gun hand takes it back; letting go then drops it.

settings.label: Gun angle
settings.help: How guns sit in your hand. Fine-tune the fit in {menu}.

settings.label: Two-handed aiming
settings.help: Both hands steer a two-handed gun; when off, the gun hand aims and the other hand only braces.

settings.label: Aim assist
settings.help: Helps shots that only just miss.

choice_help.0: Shots go exactly where you aim.
choice_help.1: Shots that just miss are nudged onto the head, as the game does for gamepads.
choice_help.2: Your own strength and range, set in {menu}.

choice_short.1: nudges near misses onto the head

settings.label: Aim assist strength
settings.help: How strongly a near miss is pulled to the head. 100% is the game's normal amount.

settings.label: Aim assist area
settings.help: How far from the head a shot can land and still get help. 100% is the game's normal area.

settings.label: Aim assist min range
settings.help: Closer shots get no help. Can't be more than the max range.

settings.label: Aim assist max range
settings.help: Farther shots get no help. Up to 100 m; can't be less than the min range.

settings.label: Bullet path
settings.help: Bullets always leave the muzzle; this sets where they fly to. Guns with no sights always shoot along the barrel.

choice_help.sight: From the muzzle to whatever your sights are on, so shots land on the sights at any range.
choice_help.bore: From the muzzle straight along the barrel, like a real gun, so shots land a little below the sights.
choice_help.converge: From the muzzle to the spot your sights are on 20 m away: on target at 20 m, a little low closer and a little high farther out.

choice_short.sight: lands on your sights at any range
choice_short.converge: on your sights at 20 m only

settings.label: Laser source
settings.help: The gun's own laser emitter where it has one, or the barrel.
settings.requires_reason: Only with the laser sight on

settings.label: Auto-return dropped guns
settings.help: Dropped guns come back to you on their own.

settings.label: Auto-return delay
settings.help: Seconds before a dropped gun comes back.

settings.label: Recall from weapon wheel
settings.help: Call a dropped gun back from the weapon wheel.

settings.label: Zed grab and throw
settings.help: Grab and throw Zeds with a free hand.

settings.label: Melee hit stop
settings.help: A short pause on melee hits so they feel solid.

settings.label: Physical melee
settings.help: Hit by swinging melee weapons with your own arm.

settings.label: Render scale
settings.help: Resolution per eye: lower runs faster but looks softer.

settings.label: DLSS
settings.help: NVIDIA upscaling for the headset; Auto uses Quality on RTX cards and stays off on others.

settings.label: Menu distance
settings.help: Distance from your head. Adjust physically in headset.

settings.label: Menu height
settings.help: Vertical offset. Backdrop changes preserve placement.

settings.label: Menu size
settings.help: Scale of the menu panel.

settings.label: Wristwatch size

settings.label: Watch forward

settings.label: Bloom
settings.help: Glow around bright lights.

settings.label: DLSS sharpening
settings.help: Sharpening after DLSS. 0% turns it off.

settings.label: Ambient occlusion
settings.help: Soft shadows in corners and under objects.

settings.label: Screen-space reflections
settings.help: Reflections on wet and shiny surfaces.

settings.label: Environment detail
settings.help: Detail of level geometry, props and foliage.

settings.label: Character detail
settings.help: Detail of Zed and player models.

settings.label: Effects quality
settings.help: Detail of muzzle flashes, fire, explosions and blood.

settings.label: Texture quality
settings.help: Texture resolution. Higher settings need more video memory.

settings.label: Texture filtering
settings.help: Sharpness of floors and walls seen at an angle. 16× is sharpest and costs little.

settings.label: Shadows
settings.help: Shadow detail and distance; one of the bigger costs.

settings.label: Volumetric lighting
settings.help: Light scattering visibly through fog and smoke.

settings.label: Light shafts
settings.help: Visible beams of light from bright sources.

settings.label: World shadow detail
settings.help: Detail of shadows from the main light. Higher is slower.

settings.label: Object shadow detail
settings.help: Detail of shadows from characters and props. Higher is slower.

settings.label: Shadow sharpness
settings.help: How crisp shadow edges are. Higher is slower.

settings.label: Shadow distance
settings.help: How far away shadows are drawn. Farther is slower.

settings.label: Gore intensity
settings.help: How much gore and dismemberment you see.

settings.label: Body limit
settings.help: More bodies look better in big waves and cost frame rate.

settings.label: Bodies react to hits
settings.help: Dead bodies still react to shots and can lose limbs.

settings.label: Ragdoll physics
settings.help: Bodies tumble and fall with real physics.

settings.label: Bodies collide with bodies
settings.help: Bodies bump into other bodies.

settings.label: Bodies collide with Zeds
settings.help: Bodies bump into living Zeds and players.

settings.label: Resting bodies collide
settings.help: Bodies that have settled still block other bodies.

settings.label: Blood effect limit
settings.help: Higher shows more and costs frame rate.

settings.label: Gore effect limit
settings.help: Higher shows more and costs frame rate.

settings.label: Splats per frame
settings.help: Higher shows more and costs frame rate.

settings.help: Higher shows more and costs frame rate.

settings.help: Higher shows more and costs frame rate.

settings.help: Higher shows more and costs frame rate.

settings.help: Longer looks messier and costs frame rate.

settings.label: Wounds last

settings.label: Splats last

settings.label: Body parts last
settings.help: Longer looks messier and costs frame rate.

settings.help: Bloat bile over your view. It costs frame rate and is heavy on the CPU.

settings.label: Brightness
settings.help: The game's brightness (gamma). Shared with its brightness screen.

settings.help: Smears the image as you move and turn.

settings.help: Overall game volume.

choice_help.2: Only while you hold Caps Lock, or a controller button you bind in your headset app.
